people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
translations.bsb: While they were trying to kill him, the commander of the Roman regiment received a report that all Jerusalem was in turmoil.
translations.kjv: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
translations.asv: And as they were seeking to kill him, tidings came up to the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in confusion.
